verdict.rationale: Cline can take an image as input: the CLI docs show referencing a screenshot with @./screenshot.png. As a general coding agent it can also create files, run commands and run dev servers, so an image-driven build is plausible. However, the only image example is fixing a layout issue, not generating an app from a design. missing for 10: documented sketch/mockup-to-app generation workflow, PDF design input, evidence the output is a working app from a design, independent or hands-on corroboration.
